requirements.text: Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline + 12+ years of professional software engineering experience; OR Master’s degree with 10+ years; OR PhD with 7+ years; OR an equivalent combination of education and verified industry software engineering experience.

Distributed Systems Engineering: Minimum of 8 years designing, building, and operating high-concurrency, distributed backend microservices in production, with demonstrable proficiency in both Go and Python.
Identity & Security: Minimum of 4 years designing and implementing enterprise authentication and authorization systems (e.g., OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, JWT, RFC 8693 token exchange, mTLS).
AI & Agentic Systems: Demonstrated experience building or integrating LLM orchestration frameworks, agentic runtimes (e.g., ReAct), tool-calling interfaces, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience deploying and operating services on Kubernetes with automated secret management and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry/APM).
Experience designing API gateways, gRPC/protobuf service definitions, and shared client libraries across large monorepos.
Experience with distributed workflow engines (e.g., Temporal) and real-time event streaming (SSE, WebSockets, Kafka).
Experience with feature flag lifecycle management and targeting using tools like LaunchDarkly.
Experience leading remediation programs in collaboration with internal offensive security or red-team penetration testing groups.
Experience integrating vector databases (e.g., Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant) and relational databases (PostgreSQL/pgx) at scale.
